name: 25 new employers — complete public boards (October 29)
description: Twenty-five additional employers absent from the baseline catalog and with no identity match found in the current Freehire directory/name checks. Every employer-specific Jobillico board passed a complete URL-inventory audit, French/English job-ID comparison, and live runtime validation with full posting descriptions. No country, title, role-count, or page-count sampling. Current postings are in Canada.

companies.note: Entire employer-specific public board; every posting has a description. French and English editions expose the same job IDs.
